name: skill-library-consistency-audit
description: Audit an ECC skill library across activation, runtime compatibility, and evidence-contract dimensions before approving deployment of fixes
diagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
  Plan[plan-skill-audit] --> Activation[audit-skill-activation]
  Plan --> Runtime[audit-runtime-compatibility]
  Plan --> Evidence[audit-evidence-contract]
  Activation --> Review[review-audit-completeness]
  Runtime --> Review
  Evidence --> Review
  Review --> Synthesize[synthesize-audit-findings]
  Synthesize --> Gate[human-gate-deploy]
  Review -.->|failure| Activation
  Review -.->|failure| Runtime
  Review -.->|failure| Evidence
```

nodes.responsibility: Define the skill-library audit scope and acceptance criteria for each independent dimension

contract.preconditions: Repository root and target skill set are known
contract.postconditions: Each audit worker has one bounded dimension and shared scope
contract.failure_output: Unresolved scope questions for the human

nodes.responsibility: Audit skill frontmatter and trigger boundaries for false negatives and false positives

contract.preconditions: Audit scope identifies target skill metadata
contract.postconditions: Every finding cites a skill path and trigger decision

nodes.responsibility: Audit runtime metadata and referenced skills for cross-IDE compatibility and availability

contract.preconditions: Local runtime root and supported platforms are declared
contract.postconditions: Each dependency is classified as available, optional, or unavailable

nodes.responsibility: Audit skill tests and evidence artifacts for reproducible acceptance criteria

contract.preconditions: Target skill test and evidence surfaces are readable
contract.postconditions: Every gap maps to a command, fixture, or artifact

nodes.responsibility: Check whether all three audit outputs cover their assigned scope with evidence
review_questions: Does every audit dimension contain complete, path-cited findings and explicit unavailable-state handling?

nodes.responsibility: Merge verified audit findings into a prioritized remediation report
Human reviews the remediation report and approves deployment of selected fixes

edges.dependency_reason: Activation auditor needs the bounded scope and target skill list
Runtime auditor needs the declared platforms and dependency scope
Evidence auditor needs the acceptance criteria and target test surfaces
Completeness reviewer needs activation findings to verify metadata coverage
Completeness reviewer needs runtime findings to verify dependency coverage
Completeness reviewer needs evidence findings to verify proof coverage
Synthesizer needs the completeness decision before merging findings
Failed completeness review routes activation gaps back for bounded revision
Failed completeness review routes runtime gaps back for bounded revision
Failed completeness review routes proof gaps back for bounded revision
Human gate needs the prioritized report before deployment approval
